"""Gate profile Wilcoxon signed-rank test: turn 1 vs last turn."""
import sys, os, json
import numpy as np
import torch
from scipy import stats

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from config import MODEL_NAME
from model_loader import load_model_with_gates
from turn_utils import build_turn_features, detect_turn_boundaries
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

CHECKPOINT_DIR = "/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/phase2_tg_s42_v7"
EVAL_DATA = "/root/turn_residual_gating/data/ultrachat_eval_sample.json"
NUM_LAYERS = 28

def main():
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    print("Loading model...")
    model, _, gate_ctx = load_model_with_gates(
        CHECKPOINT_DIR, "threadgate", MODEL_NAME
    )
    model.eval()

    with open(EVAL_DATA) as f:
        conversations = json.load(f)

    # Collect per-conv per-layer gate values for first_turn and last_turn
    all_first_turn = []  # shape will be [n_conv, 28]
    all_last_turn = []

    for ci, conv in enumerate(conversations):
        messages = conv["messages"]
        # Build chat input
        text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
        )
        input_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=2048)
        input_ids_1d = input_ids.squeeze(0)

        # Detect turn boundaries
        boundaries = detect_turn_boundaries(input_ids_1d, tokenizer)
        turns = boundaries["turns"]

        # Find first user turn and last assistant turn
        user_turns = [t for t in turns if t["role"] == "user"]
        asst_turns = [t for t in turns if t["role"] == "assistant"]
        if not user_turns or not asst_turns:
            continue

        first_user = user_turns[0]
        last_asst = asst_turns[-1]

        # Build turn features
        tf = build_turn_features(input_ids_1d, tokenizer)
        turn_features = {
            "turn_distance": tf["turn_distance"].unsqueeze(0).cuda(),
            "turn_index": tf["turn_index"].unsqueeze(0).cuda(),
        }

        # Set turn features on gate_ctx
        gate_ctx.set_turn_features(turn_features)

        # Forward pass
        with torch.no_grad():
            _ = model(input_ids=input_ids.cuda())

        gate_values = gate_ctx.gate_values

        # Extract per-layer mean gate for first_user tokens and last_asst tokens
        first_gates = np.zeros(NUM_LAYERS)
        last_gates = np.zeros(NUM_LAYERS)

        first_start = first_user["content_start"]
        first_end = first_user["content_end"]
        last_start = last_asst["content_start"]
        last_end = last_asst["content_end"]

        for layer_idx in range(NUM_LAYERS):
            g = gate_values[layer_idx].squeeze(0)  # [seq_len, 1] or [seq_len]
            if g.dim() == 2:
                g = g.squeeze(-1)
            first_gates[layer_idx] = g[first_start:first_end].float().mean().item()
            last_gates[layer_idx] = g[last_start:last_end].float().mean().item()

        all_first_turn.append(first_gates)
        all_last_turn.append(last_gates)

        if (ci + 1) % 10 == 0:
            print(f"  Processed {ci+1}/{len(conversations)}")

    all_first_turn = np.array(all_first_turn)  # [n_conv, 28]
    all_last_turn = np.array(all_last_turn)

    n_conv = len(all_first_turn)
    print(f"\nProcessed {n_conv} conversations")

    # Average across conversations: per-layer mean gate
    mean_first = all_first_turn.mean(axis=0)  # [28]
    mean_last = all_last_turn.mean(axis=0)    # [28]

    print("\n=== Per-layer gate values (mean across conversations) ===")
    print(f"{'Layer':<6} {'First turn':<12} {'Last turn':<12} {'Diff':<12}")
    for i in range(NUM_LAYERS):
        diff = mean_last[i] - mean_first[i]
        print(f"L{i:<5} {mean_first[i]:.4f}       {mean_last[i]:.4f}       {diff:+.4f}")

    # ===== Wilcoxon signed-rank test (paired, n=28 layers) =====
    # Using conversation-averaged per-layer values
    diff = mean_last - mean_first
    w_stat, p_two = stats.wilcoxon(mean_last, mean_first, alternative='two-sided')
    _, p_greater = stats.wilcoxon(mean_last, mean_first, alternative='greater')

    n = NUM_LAYERS
    z = stats.norm.ppf(1 - p_two / 2)
    effect_r = z / np.sqrt(n)

    n_positive = np.sum(diff > 0)

    print(f"\n=== Wilcoxon signed-rank test (n={n} layers) ===")
    print(f"H0: no difference between first-turn and last-turn gate values")
    print(f"H1 (one-sided): last-turn gate > first-turn gate")
    print(f"W statistic: {w_stat:.1f}")
    print(f"p-value (two-sided): {p_two:.2e}")
    print(f"p-value (one-sided, greater): {p_greater:.2e}")
    print(f"Effect size r = Z/sqrt(n) = {effect_r:.3f}")
    print(f"Layers with last > first: {n_positive}/{n}")

    # Top-5 layers by absolute difference
    abs_diff = np.abs(diff)
    top5 = np.argsort(abs_diff)[::-1][:5]
    print(f"\nTop-5 layers by |diff|:")
    for idx in top5:
        print(f"  L{idx}: diff={diff[idx]:+.4f} (first={mean_first[idx]:.4f}, last={mean_last[idx]:.4f})")

    # Mean diff with 95% CI (bootstrap across conversations)
    mean_diff_per_conv = (all_last_turn - all_first_turn).mean(axis=1)  # [n_conv]
    overall_mean_diff = mean_diff_per_conv.mean()
    se = mean_diff_per_conv.std(ddof=1) / np.sqrt(n_conv)
    ci_low = overall_mean_diff - 1.96 * se
    ci_high = overall_mean_diff + 1.96 * se
    print(f"\nMean gate difference (last - first): {overall_mean_diff:.4f} ± [{ci_low:.4f}, {ci_high:.4f}] (95% CI)")

    # ===== Per-conversation stability =====
    print(f"\n=== Per-conversation Wilcoxon tests (n={n} layers each) ===")
    p_values = []
    for ci in range(n_conv):
        first = all_first_turn[ci]
        last = all_last_turn[ci]
        try:
            _, p = stats.wilcoxon(last, first, alternative='greater')
            p_values.append(p)
        except ValueError:
            p_values.append(1.0)
    
    p_values = np.array(p_values)
    sig_count = np.sum(p_values < 0.05)
    print(f"Conversations with p < 0.05: {sig_count}/{n_conv}")
    print(f"p-value range: [{p_values.min():.2e}, {p_values.max():.2e}]")
    print(f"p-value median: {np.median(p_values):.2e}")

    # ===== Also compare by turn_index groups =====
    # For each conversation, group gate values by turn_index
    print(f"\n=== Gate values by turn index (averaged across conversations and layers) ===")
    max_turn_idx = 0
    for ci, conv in enumerate(conversations[:n_conv]):
        msgs = conv["messages"]
        n_msgs = len(msgs)
        # system + user/assistant pairs: turn indices go 0,1,2,...
        max_turn_idx = max(max_turn_idx, n_msgs)  # rough upper bound
    
    # Already have first/last. Print summary
    print(f"First user turn mean gate: {mean_first.mean():.4f} (range [{mean_first.min():.4f}, {mean_first.max():.4f}])")
    print(f"Last assistant turn mean gate: {mean_last.mean():.4f} (range [{mean_last.min():.4f}, {mean_last.max():.4f}])")

    # Save results
    results = {
        "n_conversations": n_conv,
        "n_layers": NUM_LAYERS,
        "wilcoxon_W": float(w_stat),
        "p_two_sided": float(p_two),
        "p_one_sided_greater": float(p_greater),
        "effect_size_r": float(effect_r),
        "n_layers_last_gt_first": int(n_positive),
        "mean_diff": float(overall_mean_diff),
        "ci_95_low": float(ci_low),
        "ci_95_high": float(ci_high),
        "per_layer_first_turn": mean_first.tolist(),
        "per_layer_last_turn": mean_last.tolist(),
        "per_conv_p_values": p_values.tolist(),
        "per_conv_sig_count": int(sig_count),
        "top5_layers": [{"layer": int(i), "diff": float(diff[i])} for i in top5],
    }
    out_path = "/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/v7_gate_wilcoxon_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Gate profile Wilcoxon signed-rank test: turn 1 vs last turn."""
import sys, os, json
import numpy as np
import torch
from scipy import stats

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from config import MODEL_NAME
from model_loader import load_model_with_gates
from turn_utils import build_turn_features, detect_turn_boundaries
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

CHECKPOINT_DIR = "/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/phase2_tg_s42_v7"
EVAL_DATA = "/root/turn_residual_gating/data/ultrachat_eval_sample.json"
NUM_LAYERS = 28

def main():
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    print("Loading model...")
    model, _, gate_ctx = load_model_with_gates(
        CHECKPOINT_DIR, "threadgate", MODEL_NAME
    )
    model.eval()

    with open(EVAL_DATA) as f:
        conversations = json.load(f)

    all_first_turn = []
    all_last_turn = []

    for ci, conv in enumerate(conversations):
        messages = conv["messages"]
        text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
        )
        input_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=2048)
        input_ids_1d = input_ids.squeeze(0)

        boundaries = detect_turn_boundaries(input_ids_1d, tokenizer)
        turns = boundaries["turns"]

        user_turns = [t for t in turns if t["role"] == "user"]
        asst_turns = [t for t in turns if t["role"] == "assistant"]
        if not user_turns or not asst_turns:
            continue

        first_user = user_turns[0]
        last_asst = asst_turns[-1]

        # Prepare the tracker so gate hooks activate during forward pass
        device = torch.device("cuda")
        gate_ctx.prepare_generation(input_ids, tokenizer, max_new_tokens=1, device=device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            _ = model(input_ids=input_ids.cuda())

        gate_values = gate_ctx.gate_values

        first_gates = np.zeros(NUM_LAYERS)
        last_gates = np.zeros(NUM_LAYERS)

        first_start = first_user["content_start"]
        first_end = first_user["content_end"]
        last_start = last_asst["content_start"]
        last_end = last_asst["content_end"]

        for layer_idx in range(NUM_LAYERS):
            g = gate_values[layer_idx].squeeze(0)  # [seq_len, 1]
            if g.dim() == 2:
                g = g.squeeze(-1)
            first_gates[layer_idx] = g[first_start:first_end].float().mean().item()
            last_gates[layer_idx] = g[last_start:last_end].float().mean().item()

        all_first_turn.append(first_gates)
        all_last_turn.append(last_gates)

        if (ci + 1) % 10 == 0:
            print(f"  Processed {ci+1}/{len(conversations)}")

    all_first_turn = np.array(all_first_turn)  # [n_conv, 28]
    all_last_turn = np.array(all_last_turn)

    n_conv = len(all_first_turn)
    print(f"\nProcessed {n_conv} conversations")

    mean_first = all_first_turn.mean(axis=0)
    mean_last = all_last_turn.mean(axis=0)

    print("\n=== Per-layer gate values (mean across conversations) ===")
    print(f"{'Layer':<6} {'First turn':<12} {'Last turn':<12} {'Diff':<12}")
    for i in range(NUM_LAYERS):
        d = mean_last[i] - mean_first[i]
        print(f"L{i:<5} {mean_first[i]:.4f}       {mean_last[i]:.4f}       {d:+.4f}")

    diff = mean_last - mean_first

    # Wilcoxon signed-rank test
    w_stat, p_two = stats.wilcoxon(mean_last, mean_first, alternative='two-sided')
    _, p_greater = stats.wilcoxon(mean_last, mean_first, alternative='greater')

    n = NUM_LAYERS
    # Compute Z from p-value for effect size
    z = stats.norm.ppf(1 - p_two / 2)
    effect_r = z / np.sqrt(n)

    n_positive = int(np.sum(diff > 0))

    print(f"\n=== Wilcoxon signed-rank test (n={n} layers) ===")
    print(f"W statistic: {w_stat:.1f}")
    print(f"p-value (two-sided): {p_two:.2e}")
    print(f"p-value (one-sided, greater): {p_greater:.2e}")
    print(f"Effect size r = {effect_r:.3f}")
    print(f"Layers with last > first: {n_positive}/{n}")

    abs_diff = np.abs(diff)
    top5 = np.argsort(abs_diff)[::-1][:5]
    print(f"\nTop-5 layers by |diff|:")
    for idx in top5:
        print(f"  L{idx}: diff={diff[idx]:+.4f} (first={mean_first[idx]:.4f}, last={mean_last[idx]:.4f})")

    # Mean diff with 95% CI
    mean_diff_per_conv = (all_last_turn - all_first_turn).mean(axis=1)
    overall_mean_diff = mean_diff_per_conv.mean()
    se = mean_diff_per_conv.std(ddof=1) / np.sqrt(n_conv)
    ci_low = overall_mean_diff - 1.96 * se
    ci_high = overall_mean_diff + 1.96 * se
    print(f"\nMean gate diff (last - first): {overall_mean_diff:.4f} [{ci_low:.4f}, {ci_high:.4f}] (95% CI)")

    # Per-conversation Wilcoxon
    print(f"\n=== Per-conversation Wilcoxon tests ===")
    p_values = []
    for ci in range(n_conv):
        first = all_first_turn[ci]
        last = all_last_turn[ci]
        try:
            _, p = stats.wilcoxon(last, first, alternative='greater')
            p_values.append(p)
        except ValueError:
            p_values.append(1.0)
    
    p_values = np.array(p_values)
    sig_count = int(np.sum(p_values < 0.05))
    print(f"Conversations with p < 0.05: {sig_count}/{n_conv}")
    print(f"p-value range: [{p_values.min():.2e}, {p_values.max():.2e}]")
    print(f"p-value median: {np.median(p_values):.2e}")

    print(f"\nFirst user turn overall mean gate: {mean_first.mean():.4f}")
    print(f"Last assistant turn overall mean gate: {mean_last.mean():.4f}")

    results = {
        "n_conversations": n_conv,
        "n_layers": NUM_LAYERS,
        "wilcoxon_W": float(w_stat),
        "p_two_sided": float(p_two),
        "p_one_sided_greater": float(p_greater),
        "effect_size_r": float(effect_r),
        "n_layers_last_gt_first": n_positive,
        "mean_diff": float(overall_mean_diff),
        "ci_95_low": float(ci_low),
        "ci_95_high": float(ci_high),
        "per_layer_first_turn": mean_first.tolist(),
        "per_layer_last_turn": mean_last.tolist(),
        "per_conv_p_values": p_values.tolist(),
        "per_conv_sig_count": sig_count,
        "top5_layers": [{"layer": int(i), "diff": float(diff[i])} for i in top5],
    }
    out_path = "/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/v7_gate_wilcoxon_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Gate profile Wilcoxon signed-rank test: turn 1 vs last turn."""
import sys, os, json
import numpy as np
import torch
from scipy import stats

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from config import MODEL_NAME
from model_loader import load_model_with_gates
from turn_utils import build_turn_features, detect_turn_boundaries
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

CHECKPOINT_DIR = "/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/phase2_tg_s42_v7"
EVAL_DATA = "/root/turn_residual_gating/data/ultrachat_eval_sample.json"
NUM_LAYERS = 28

def main():
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    print("Loading model...")
    model, _, gate_ctx = load_model_with_gates(
        CHECKPOINT_DIR, "threadgate", MODEL_NAME,
        device_map={"": "cuda:0"}
    )
    model.eval()
    device = torch.device("cuda:0")

    with open(EVAL_DATA) as f:
        conversations = json.load(f)

    all_first_turn = []
    all_last_turn = []

    for ci, conv in enumerate(conversations):
        messages = conv["messages"]
        text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
        )
        input_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=2048)
        input_ids_1d = input_ids.squeeze(0)

        boundaries = detect_turn_boundaries(input_ids_1d, tokenizer)
        turns = boundaries["turns"]

        user_turns = [t for t in turns if t["role"] == "user"]
        asst_turns = [t for t in turns if t["role"] == "assistant"]
        if not user_turns or not asst_turns:
            continue

        first_user = user_turns[0]
        last_asst = asst_turns[-1]

        gate_ctx.prepare_generation(input_ids, tokenizer, max_new_tokens=1, device=device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            _ = model(input_ids=input_ids.to(device))

        gate_values = gate_ctx.gate_values

        first_gates = np.zeros(NUM_LAYERS)
        last_gates = np.zeros(NUM_LAYERS)

        first_start = first_user["content_start"]
        first_end = first_user["content_end"]
        last_start = last_asst["content_start"]
        last_end = last_asst["content_end"]

        for layer_idx in range(NUM_LAYERS):
            g = gate_values[layer_idx].squeeze(0)
            if g.dim() == 2:
                g = g.squeeze(-1)
            first_gates[layer_idx] = g[first_start:first_end].float().mean().item()
            last_gates[layer_idx] = g[last_start:last_end].float().mean().item()

        all_first_turn.append(first_gates)
        all_last_turn.append(last_gates)

        if (ci + 1) % 10 == 0:
            print(f"  Processed {ci+1}/{len(conversations)}")

    all_first_turn = np.array(all_first_turn)
    all_last_turn = np.array(all_last_turn)

    n_conv = len(all_first_turn)
    print(f"\nProcessed {n_conv} conversations")

    mean_first = all_first_turn.mean(axis=0)
    mean_last = all_last_turn.mean(axis=0)

    print("\n=== Per-layer gate values (mean across conversations) ===")
    print(f"{'Layer':<6} {'First turn':<12} {'Last turn':<12} {'Diff':<12}")
    for i in range(NUM_LAYERS):
        d = mean_last[i] - mean_first[i]
        print(f"L{i:<5} {mean_first[i]:.4f}       {mean_last[i]:.4f}       {d:+.4f}")

    diff = mean_last - mean_first

    w_stat, p_two = stats.wilcoxon(mean_last, mean_first, alternative='two-sided')
    _, p_greater = stats.wilcoxon(mean_last, mean_first, alternative='greater')

    n = NUM_LAYERS
    z = stats.norm.ppf(1 - p_two / 2)
    effect_r = z / np.sqrt(n)

    n_positive = int(np.sum(diff > 0))

    print(f"\n=== Wilcoxon signed-rank test (n={n} layers) ===")
    print(f"W statistic: {w_stat:.1f}")
    print(f"p-value (two-sided): {p_two:.2e}")
    print(f"p-value (one-sided, greater): {p_greater:.2e}")
    print(f"Effect size r = {effect_r:.3f}")
    print(f"Layers with last > first: {n_positive}/{n}")

    abs_diff = np.abs(diff)
    top5 = np.argsort(abs_diff)[::-1][:5]
    print(f"\nTop-5 layers by |diff|:")
    for idx in top5:
        print(f"  L{idx}: diff={diff[idx]:+.4f} (first={mean_first[idx]:.4f}, last={mean_last[idx]:.4f})")

    mean_diff_per_conv = (all_last_turn - all_first_turn).mean(axis=1)
    overall_mean_diff = mean_diff_per_conv.mean()
    se = mean_diff_per_conv.std(ddof=1) / np.sqrt(n_conv)
    ci_low = overall_mean_diff - 1.96 * se
    ci_high = overall_mean_diff + 1.96 * se
    print(f"\nMean gate diff (last - first): {overall_mean_diff:.4f} [{ci_low:.4f}, {ci_high:.4f}] (95% CI)")

    print(f"\n=== Per-conversation Wilcoxon tests ===")
    p_values = []
    for ci in range(n_conv):
        first = all_first_turn[ci]
        last = all_last_turn[ci]
        try:
            _, p = stats.wilcoxon(last, first, alternative='greater')
            p_values.append(p)
        except ValueError:
            p_values.append(1.0)
    
    p_values = np.array(p_values)
    sig_count = int(np.sum(p_values < 0.05))
    print(f"Conversations with p < 0.05: {sig_count}/{n_conv}")
    print(f"p-value range: [{p_values.min():.2e}, {p_values.max():.2e}]")
    print(f"p-value median: {np.median(p_values):.2e}")

    print(f"\nFirst user turn overall mean gate: {mean_first.mean():.4f}")
    print(f"Last assistant turn overall mean gate: {mean_last.mean():.4f}")

    results = {
        "n_conversations": n_conv,
        "n_layers": NUM_LAYERS,
        "wilcoxon_W": float(w_stat),
        "p_two_sided": float(p_two),
        "p_one_sided_greater": float(p_greater),
        "effect_size_r": float(effect_r),
        "n_layers_last_gt_first": n_positive,
        "mean_diff": float(overall_mean_diff),
        "ci_95_low": float(ci_low),
        "ci_95_high": float(ci_high),
        "per_layer_first_turn": mean_first.tolist(),
        "per_layer_last_turn": mean_last.tolist(),
        "per_conv_p_values": p_values.tolist(),
        "per_conv_sig_count": sig_count,
        "top5_layers": [{"layer": int(i), "diff": float(diff[i])} for i in top5],
    }
    out_path = "/root/turn_residual_gating/runs/v7_gate_wilcoxon_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
